items.setting: Town watch repair counter: a repairer behind the counter speaking with a customer who brought in a watch.

worlds.keyAct: declines the repair in favor of buying new
worlds.line: The movement's cracked — a repair would cost more than the watch is worth.
worlds.reply: Then I'd rather put that money toward a new one.
worlds.explanationIfSpoken: Told that fixing the watch would cost more than the watch is worth, deciding to put the money toward a new one is the natural response. Asking to swap the battery while waiting ignores the verdict that repair isn't worthwhile, and 'just the strap for now' answers a glass-or-strap choice that was never posed. Wanting initials engraved responds to a free-engraving offer nobody made.

kills.1: The line judges fixing to cost "more than the watch is worth", so there is no cheap battery swap on the table to wait for.
kills.2: It declares that "a repair would cost" too much overall; no glass-versus-strap choice is offered, so picking just the strap answers a question never asked.
kills.3: A verdict that fixing exceeds what "the watch is worth" contains no engraving offer for initials to accept.

worlds.keyAct: asks for immediate service on the spot
worlds.line: Good timing — we just got the exact battery your model needs.
worlds.reply: Could you swap the battery in while I wait?
worlds.explanationIfSpoken: When the shop announces the exact battery has just arrived, asking to have it swapped in while waiting follows directly. Abandoning the watch for a new one makes no sense when the fix is a cheap battery, and 'just the strap for now' answers a scope question nobody asked. Requesting initials engraved responds to an offer that was never made.

kills.0: Announcing that "the exact battery" has arrived is cheap good news, not a cost verdict that would justify buying a new watch.
kills.2: The line concerns the "battery your model" needs; no scratched glass or strap choice exists to narrow down.
kills.3: Saying "we just got" a battery offers no free engraving, so asking for initials responds to nothing said.

worlds.explanationIfSpoken: Asked whether to replace the scratched glass too or just the strap, choosing just the strap and dismissing the glass answers the question exactly.
